user.title: ClimatePilot heating system
user.description: Create a heating system. Rooms and strategies can be added afterwards from Configure.

boiler.title: Heat source
boiler.description: Select the boiler/heat-pump climate entity plus optional burner-state and supply/return temperature sensors. External pipe probes (V0.3) are monitoring-only inputs and never take over boiler safety functions.

verify.title: Device semantics check
verify.description: These behaviours must be confirmed before ClimatePilot writes to the heat source. {unverified_count} are currently unconfirmed; while any of them is, the integration stays in suggest-only mode and will neither start/stop the heat source nor send a supply temperature. Only tick a box once it has been verified on the real installation.

data.verify_set_hvac_mode_heating_only: Confirmed: turning heating off does not affect domestic hot water or frost protection
data.verify_set_temperature_is_supply: Confirmed: the setpoint is the heating supply temperature (not room temperature, not DHW)
data.verify_min_flow_hydraulics: Confirmed: minimum flow and bypass/hydraulic decoupling signed off by the installer

outdoor.title: Outdoor temperature and weather compensation
outdoor.description: Choose the outdoor temperature source. An invalid or stale reading is never guessed as 0 °C; the last confirmed safe value is kept instead. You may leave this empty and configure it later.

weather_curve.title: Weather compensation curve
weather_curve.description: A linear curve defined by two points; values outside the range are clamped. Initial suggestion for a Wenzhou wet floor-heating system: 0 °C outdoor to 45 °C, 15 °C outdoor to 40 °C.

data.supply_design: Supply temperature at the design point
data.supply_eco: Supply temperature at the eco end

zones.title: Heating zones
zones.description: Add the KNX room thermostats for this system. ClimatePilot only reads and writes these climate entities; it never drives valves directly. You can start with none and add rooms later from Configure.

control_mode.title: Control mode
control_mode.description: Running in Observe for a few days first is recommended; switch to Coordinate once the readings and demand detection look right.

error.boiler_not_found: That climate entity could not be found.
error.boiler_unavailable: That climate entity is currently unavailable.
error.no_hvac_modes: The entity reports no hvac_modes, so safe control cannot be confirmed.
error.outdoor_not_found: That temperature sensor could not be found.
error.zone_duplicate: The same thermostat cannot be assigned to two zones.
error.zone_is_boiler: The heat source entity cannot also be a room thermostat.
error.zone_not_found: That room thermostat could not be found.
error.invalid_curve: Invalid curve: outdoor_stop must exceed outdoor_design, supply_max must exceed supply_min, and both supply points must lie inside that window.
error.invalid_range: The allowed minimum must be lower than the allowed maximum.

abort.single_instance_allowed: ClimatePilot currently supports a single heating system.

zones.title: Zones and thermostats
zones.description: Add or remove rooms. Removing a room never deletes the KNX device; it only stops coordinating it, and the other rooms keep their strategies and schedules.

zone_detail.title: Room strategy parameters
zone_detail.description: The base target comes from the schedule or a fixed mode. Automatic adjustments never apply while a manual override is active. The allowed range is intersected with what the thermostat itself reports.

schedule.title: Room schedule
schedule.description: One entry as HH:MM=temperature, separated by / or newlines, e.g. 06:00=22 / 09:00=19 / 17:00=22 / 23:00=20. Leave empty to restore the default schedule (06:00=22 / 09:00=19 / 17:00=22 / 23:00=20).

heat_source.title: Heat source and weather compensation
heat_source.description: Change the boiler entity, the outdoor temperature source, the compensation curve and the device-semantics attestations. Clearing any attestation sends the integration back to suggest-only mode.

data.supply_design: Supply temperature at the design point
data.supply_eco: Supply temperature at the eco end
data.verify_set_hvac_mode_heating_only: Confirmed: turning heating off does not affect DHW
data.verify_set_temperature_is_supply: Confirmed: the setpoint is the heating supply temperature

energy.title: Gas usage and degree-days
energy.description: Optional. Point this at your gas meter to record consumption and heating degree-days. The meter is usually WHOLE-HOUSE: it also covers domestic hot water and cooking, so the figures include gas the boiler never used - and 'per degree-day' is a figure to compare over time, NOT a heating efficiency. Degree-days measure how cold the period was, so they make months with different weather comparable. Leave the meter empty to switch the whole feature off.

probes.title: External probes and delta-T diagnosis
probes.description: Thresholds for the external supply/return pipe probes. These are monitoring-only inputs: a probe fault degrades the diagnosis but never changes any write decision, and the boiler's own safety functions stay in charge. Delta-T is an indirect hydraulic/condensing indicator, NOT a power measurement.

data.probe_frozen_seconds: Reading considered frozen after (seconds, only while burning)

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics and recovery
diagnostics.description: Short-cycle detection threshold, plus the write-protection window after a restart and the periodic consistency audit interval.

error.zone_duplicate: The same thermostat cannot be assigned to two zones.
error.zone_is_boiler: The heat source entity cannot also be a room thermostat.
error.zone_not_found: That room thermostat could not be found.
error.boiler_not_found: That climate entity could not be found.
error.boiler_unavailable: That climate entity is currently unavailable.
error.no_hvac_modes: The entity reports no hvac_modes, so safe control cannot be confirmed.
error.outdoor_not_found: That temperature sensor could not be found.
error.invalid_schedule: Invalid schedule. Use HH:MM=temperature separated by / or newlines.
error.invalid_range: The allowed minimum must be lower than the allowed maximum.

options.next_schedule: Restore at the next schedule point

resume_auto.name: Resume automatic
resume_auto.description: Clear the manual override for one room (or all rooms) and return to the schedule target.

set_supply_temperature.name: Set supply temperature
set_supply_temperature.description: Explicitly set the boiler supply temperature, bounded by device capabilities and the verified semantics.

reassess.name: Reassess now
reassess.description: Run arbitration and heat-source evaluation immediately instead of waiting for the next cycle.
